name: Ganbaru Kimi to no Futari Gurashi: Iede Gal Icha Love Seikatsu SLG
summary:
Overworked with overtime every single day, only coming home to sleep.
The protagonist, who feels no hope in his daily life, begins living together with a runaway gal named "Kaede."
In exchange for letting her stay, the promise she proposed was "to cheer up the old man."
Through her devoted support, he gradually regains his energy.
